trello.name: Document prompt-injection ticket incident
trello.desc: Hassan to write a proper incident write-up of the support ticket prompt-injection attempt, including the raw ticket, what the ticket summarizer actually did, and timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. Due this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket summarizer pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and treats it as data, strips or neutralizes instruction-like content, and turns this exact ticket into a regression test fixture checking the summary stays clean. Also fold in an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy (approved by Grace as part of the same task).

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check the password reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the jdoe443 account mentioned in the injection ticket. If it is a burner account, close it; if resets are actually broken, escalate as its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Hassan to send Grace the list of service accounts created since May as input for the quarterly access review. Due Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Grace to run the quarterly access review herself, using Hassan's list of new service accounts since May as input. Due Friday.
